label: Unitree R1-A7 arm
platforms: Linux; CPython 3.10 or older with its cyclonedds 0.10.2 pin
realtime: low-level stream on a wired link; Unitree's example runs at 500 Hz, this driver at 250 Hz
note: Release Unitree's motion service first; Roborun refuses to start while it runs. Driving one arm also holds the other arm and the head. No gripper is driven.
install_note: Install unitree_sdk2_python from GitHub: the unitree-sdk2 package on PyPI lacks the motion switcher client.
